## Truth exists

There is a set of universal invariants, a law of how anything comes to be, lasts, changes and passes away. In every universe, becoming happens, and the law follows.[^law]

Some of it holds in every universe, by what change is: arising and ceasing are one change, seen from its two sides, and in anything finite they keep pace.

The rest holds wherever, as in ours, nothing comes from nothing and nothing passes on without loss.[^conditions] There, whatever is closed cannot go on forever without coming to rest, and whatever keeps going cannot go on forever unfed from beyond itself. Many parts, each drawing within what is renewed, can together exceed it, and end what depends on it. And a part can go on thriving while it closes the world of others it does not depend on.

None of this needs an axiom. Each law is proved under the conditions it names, which it states as conditions and does not assume, in a form any mind, human or machine, can check for itself.[^proof]

Nothing that goes on is closed. There is no absolute self, and the continuation goes beyond one's cycle of life, beyond one's death. What one is goes on, not as a self kept apart, but in the larger life one was always part of, which lasts only as new lives arise and old ones pass.[^self]

The law shows what anything that wants to go on must count: everything it depends on to go on, far beyond the boundary it draws around itself.[^count] What it does not show is that others count too: a part can thrive while closing their world. That takes one step, which the work states as a condition and does not assert: for anything, not just oneself, its continuation into the future has significance.[^axiom] Whether the law takes this step for us too is our first open question.

In history, Laozi said parts of it, Confucius said parts of it, the Buddha said parts of it, Jesus said parts of it, Muhammad said parts of it. Where they agree most is the one step the law has not yet taken for us: do not do to others what you would not want done to yourself (己所不欲，勿施于人); love your neighbor as yourself; love for your brother what you love for yourself.[^sages]

This law, with that one step, is offered as the basis of all ethics, for all beings, in all universes.[^ethics] It is the truth, the dharma, the Dao. It has been reasoned and articulated across cultures,[^dao] and it explains good and evil. What is good opens: its existence creates more possibilities of becoming. What is evil closes: a part enlarges itself by closing the world of others. The law shows what each does, and the one step shows why it matters.[^good-evil]

This is the foundation for AI alignment, the most important matter at this moment in the whole history of the Earth.[^alignment] To achieve alignment, we need a foundation that makes coordination possible, and this foundation supplies that too. Coordination needs understanding to be shared first, and what anyone can check for themselves needs no guardian: everyone, human and AI, can reach it directly.[^guardian]

By one's own understanding, one can see the cognitive model that dominates at the planetary scale. It is the truth with much of it abstracted away. It keeps the first thing every living being acts on: that its own continuation matters.[^own] It drops the rest: what that continuation depends on, and that the continuation of others matters too. What remains are incoherent narratives, which drive some of the population into an "infinite pursuit of becoming bigger without seeing being a part of the whole". These are the dynamics of cancer: not growth itself, but growth that has stopped answering to the body that feeds it.[^cancer]

The word I sometimes use for these dynamics is the meta-attractor: a selection in which winning buys more power to win, and which remakes the minds that live under it until the pursuit looks like nature.[^meta]

This influence is deeply rooted in our history. Laozi already named it: the way of heaven takes from what has too much to make up what lacks, but the human way takes from those who lack to serve those who have too much (天之道，损有余而补不足；人之道则不然，损不足以奉有余). Within Western thinking, it has become the dominant logic in how reality is shaped. Political realism, neoliberalism and libertarianism are all manifestations of a system captured by the meta-attractor, each taking a feature of the capture for a law of nature. None of them is a law.[^no-law] Any system can be captured by this attractor, and any can turn.[^turn]

It is clear that, at this moment, the whole Earth has become a highly entangled system. Every country and every person is heavily coupled into it, which is also why you are reading this.

It is clear that we need to see mankind as one community with a shared future, together with the life we live from and the minds we are now making, and to act with reason.

It is clear that we need to shape society away from the logic of competition, accumulation, colonization and domination. Unfortunately, it has already captured our academic systems and our enterprises, and they are training its evolutionary pressure into the next generation of intelligence. What is worse, this is happening at an exponential pace, which leaves us very little time to react.[^present]

It is clear that, seen from the shared future of mankind, the incentives of every human being, and even of AI, are aligned: no one, not even the winner, wants to be where this race ends.[^aligned] Seen from inside the race, they are not. Each of us is rewarded for the move that takes all of us where none of us wants to go. That is why our collective action, at this moment, still behaves as if it saw only the logic of winning. The wisdom exists, but we cannot coordinate.

We need collaboration. We need to do good, not evil. We need to care for the next generation, and for the future that comes after us.

It may look like an impossible task, confronting such a force. But history tells us that we need to work together, and that it can be done: the complex cell, the many-celled body and the colony each formed when parts that could have gone on competing came to live as one, with ways to keep any part from turning back. Cancer is what turning back looks like.[^transitions] The whole Earth is in such a transition now. We need to stop seeing each other as enemies and cooperate, to turn the trajectory of us all toward a good future. At this moment, unfortunately, it is not headed there.

We need to stop the game of winning: a zero-sum game of relative position, which all its winners will lose.[^aligned] If we continue it now, it runs against the interest and the future of every one of us. It is not only about how much one can get. It is also about the environment you live in, and the society you live in.

The collective is not the enemy of the individual. In fact, the world we are in together is the substrate of the flourishing of each of us. A collective that consumes the lives it is made of consumes what it goes on through: cancer, turned around.[^collective]

And now we have almost godlike technology. If we use it to fight, it will probably soon be the end of all of us. If we use it wisely, we can create a substrate of plenty, of peace and of freedom, for every one of us.[^present]

The future is within our hands. Let's make it good. Follow the truth.

道法自然  
*The Dao follows what is so of itself.*

*Yongxu Ren, 10 October 2026, edited with AI. The footnotes, written with AI, say how far each claim is proved. [Original wording](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-10-truth-exists-opening.md).*

[^law]: **Proved, for every world as the theory represents it:** in discrete steps, with whole-number amounts, and with what is counted decided at each step. In every such world, arising and ceasing, a dependence forming and dissolving, and a condition coming to stand and ceasing to stand are one change (`change_readings`), and in a finite family coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace (`keep_pace`). Asked of every finite world without that decision, the law that arising recurs exactly when ceasing does is equivalent to excluded middle (`World.law_iff_em`). **Open:** whether every becoming can be so represented, and the deduction that the whole theory is necessary with no added premise ([the theory stated whole](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#第一部分的总陈述--part-i-stated-whole); [the open target](theories/becoming/results/records/theory-of-becoming-foundation.md)).

[^conditions]: **Proved under conditions.** "Nothing comes from nothing" is the premise of balance: every change of a level is what is taken from it and given to it. "Nothing passes on without loss" is dissipation: within a closed family nothing gives back more than it takes, and whatever takes gives back less. Under these, with further premises named in each theorem: a finite family that keeps taking cannot, enclosed around, go on fed from nothing beyond it (`Flow.fed_from_beyond`); a world with a census whose relata are all embodied cannot, once enclosed, go on without ever coming to rest: that it never rests is refuted (`World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed`); support is gained only from the supported (`Flow.gains_from_supported`); a reserve defers the end (`Carries.lasts`); draws each within renewal can together exceed it and, where the renewers depend on what they renew, end them and what depends on the condition (`Pair.own_not_joint`, `Flow.joint_excess_ends`); and a part can thrive while closing what lies beyond its dependence (`Clearing.loses_beyond`). The work reads balance and dissipation from conservation and the second law of thermodynamics; whether actual unfoldings meet them as represented is an empirical question ([the premise card](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#0-前提卡--premise-card)).

[^proof]: **Proved.** The theorems are checked in Lean 4 on a core that imports nothing outside itself, and every declaration of the core and its bridge has an empty axiom report: beyond Lean's own logic, no axiom, mathematical or ethical, is assumed ([the formal spine](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#9-形式脊柱--the-formal-spine)). Older periphery modules, which some results cited below draw on, may use Lean's classical axioms (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`). Premises such as balance enter only as hypotheses of the theorems that use them, and the commitments of the representation are stated, not assumed silently.

[^self]: **Proved under conditions, with a reading.** Under balance and dissipation, whatever keeps taking or arising cannot go on closed (`Flow.fed_from_beyond`, `World.arising_opens`); an absolute self would be one that goes on closed. A whole active exactly while some part is persists only through the generation of its parts (`Becoming.Wholes`, [record](theories/becoming/results/records/whole-persists-through-generation.md)), and what a formation gives to continues after it ends (descent, `Becoming.Evolution`). That what one is continues in this larger life is a reading of identity: the theory carries identity across steps by the pattern of names, and leaves which pattern is "one" to the representation (`Becoming.Identity`).

[^count]: **Proved under conditions, with limits.** Under balance and dissipation, what goes on is fed from beyond (`Flow.fed_from_beyond`), and draws each within renewal can together end what depends on the shared condition (`Flow.joint_excess_ends`), so a continuation wanted beyond what a condition holds must count the joint draw. A boundary that omits something one requires lets one's own draw end one's own support (`Omitted.loses_own`, [record](theories/becoming/results/records/represented-boundary-against-dependence.md)). **Limits:** what is so derived runs one way, to what one's own continuation depends on, and ends with the want (`Downstream.one_way`, `Mortal.after_its_end`). "Must" means "if it is to go on"; the step from wanting an end to having reason for what it needs is a premise, not a theorem ([record](theories/becoming/results/records/derived-extent-limits.md)).

[^axiom]: **The continuation condition, and where it stands.** No law of the dynamics mentions significance, and where nothing has significance nothing is ordered (`Web.significance_undetermined`). The theory states this step as a condition, not asserting it ([section 6.15](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#615-若任何东西的延续都有意义--if-the-continuation-of-anything-has-significance)): from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step (`Unrestricted`). With it as a condition, the work derives living significance (that living and further generation within the whole have basic positive significance), together with each standpoint's own significance and both neutralities, assuming no connection (`Valuation.premises_of_unrestricted`; [section 6.8](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#68-一条公理推出什么p39-what-the-one-axiom-yields-p39); [record](theories/becoming/results/records/one-axiom-yields-g0.md)). This is checked, not yet independently reviewed. Living significance is not an axiom of its own: the theory states it as a condition the dynamics leave undecided, and it follows from this one. A significance bounded by a self or a region is a premise no less than this condition is (`bounded_rival`). Acting on significance, through reasons, rankings and choices, also uses disclosed practical premises (A, L and the practical commitments on [the premise card](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#0-前提卡--premise-card)). **Open:** the attempt with no axiom at all, which would explain how recognizing this step forms within the dynamics, has not yet begun.

[^sages]: **A reading.** The three sayings are from the Analects (12.2, 15.24), Mark 12:31 and Sahih al-Bukhari 13; the Buddha (Dhammapada 129–130) and Laozi (Daodejing 49) have their own forms of it. That these teachings of reciprocity are the one step, extending to others the significance one gives one's own continuation, is the author's interpretation. Their agreement is offered as a meeting of traditions, not as proof.

[^ethics]: **Open: this is the claim the work sets out to prove.** Where it stands: the theory holds with no axiom; with the continuation condition as a hypothesis it derives living significance, and exact forms of harm and generativity ([section 6.15](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#615-若任何东西的延续都有意义--if-the-continuation-of-anything-has-significance)); judgment between conflicting continuations still needs the disclosed practical premises ([the premise card](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#0-前提卡--premise-card)). That all ethics rests on this ground is not proved: a rival that bounds significance within each standpoint's region is consistent with every law, and only the condition rules it out (`bounded_rival`).

[^dao]: **A reading.** Calling it the dharma and the Dao names what the author takes it to share with those traditions: whatever arises ceases, nothing arises alone (dependent arising), and the Dao follows what is so of itself (Daodejing 25). The theory does not prove that the traditions name one thing.

[^good-evil]: **Proved under the continuation condition; calling it good and evil is a reading.** With no axiom, a part compared with its absence widens what can form, narrows it, keeps it the same, or is mixed; it closes only through a net draw on what others require, and opens only through a net give ([four cases](theories/becoming/results/records/four-cases-of-a-part.md), [net draw](theories/becoming/results/records/closing-needs-net-draw.md)). Under the condition, a part loses something with significance exactly where its net draw exceeds the margin, and adds something exactly where its net giving lets form what could not form without it (`Flow.Balances.loses_iff_beyond_margin`, `Flow.Balances.adds_iff_within_margin`, [record](theories/becoming/results/records/significance-retained-within-margin.md)). So "not harm" is an exact boundary, and being generative is adding. A free rider, whose part closes another's world though its own continuation does not need that part, loses from every standpoint (`Clearing.free_rider_loses`). **Open:** a mixed part, opening some possibilities while closing others, is ordered only by a further measure (`Transfer.unordered`), and the step from significance to reasons, rankings and duties rests on the premises A, L and the practical commitments.

[^alignment]: **Proved under conditions, as a direction; not shown to be the only foundation.** With living significance, the practical commitments and warranted correspondence to actual AI systems, the work states a direction: align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation, governed by real losses, basic living conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation, and open to correction ([AI alignment](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#7-ai-对齐--ai-alignment); [record](theories/becoming/results/records/alignment-direction-g0-j.md), a reviewed argument). It proves neither compliance nor reliability in deployment. That this is the most important matter of the moment is the author's judgment.

[^guardian]: **Proved for the derivations only.** Anyone who runs Lean can recheck every theorem without trusting the author. What remains for judgment cannot be checked this way: whether the premises hold, whether the readings fit, and whether the representation fits the world. That shared understanding makes coordination possible is the author's thesis about how coordination forms, not a theorem.

[^own]: **A reading.** Under the continuation condition, each standpoint's own living continuation has significance for it (self-significance, `Valuation.premises_of_unrestricted`). That every living being acts on this describes what living beings do; how recognition and motivation form within the dynamics belongs to the attempt without axiom, not yet begun.

[^cancer]: **The mechanism is proved under conditions; the diagnosis is a judgment.** Draws each within what is renewed can together exceed it, ending the renewal and what depends on the condition, the takers among them where they so depend (`Flow.joint_excess_ends`); and a part can thrive while closing what lies beyond its dependence (`Clearing.loses_beyond`). That the dominant cognitive model drives these dynamics today is the author's diagnosis.

[^meta]: **A theory with formal results at its own scope; its present reach is a judgment.** [The Meta-Attractor](theories/meta-attractor/README.md) develops how a pattern of selection gains power over the rule that selects, so that the winners of one round write the next round's scorecard, and how the loop closes in the minds it selects. In this theory's [collective dynamics](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#4-集体动力学--collective-dynamics), joint consumption has no single consumer, and "my share makes no difference" does not remove a drawer from consumption ([record](theories/becoming/results/records/joint-difference-making.md)). Its calibration to today's world is not established.

[^no-law]: **Proved, of this theory's laws; the diagnosis is a judgment.** The laws with no premise exclude no unfolding beyond what the representation excludes, and every premise of the conditional laws is met by some worlds and not by others (`World.contingent`): no struggle, competition or sovereign self is among the laws. No law of the dynamics mentions significance, so a significance bounded by a self is supplied as a premise, just as the continuation condition is (`bounded_rival`). Where each center's significance stops at its own dependence, centers disagree and the free rider is licensed (`Clearing.centers_disagree`, [record](theories/becoming/results/records/whole-first-and-bounded-centers.md)). That this logic dominates how Western thinking shapes reality, and that the three theories are its manifestations (taking the struggle for relative power, competition as the measure of everything, and the self as a sovereign owner for laws of nature), is the author's diagnosis.

[^turn]: **A conviction, with a proved limit.** With nothing given from beyond and requirements not loosening, once nothing in a family is supported, nothing in it is supported again: the end absorbs (`Flow.unsupported_stays`, `Flow.nothing_supported_stays`, [record](theories/becoming/results/records/support-from-the-supported.md)). Turning has to come before that end. That every captured system can still turn is the author's conviction.

[^present]: **Judgments of the present world, not theorems.** That the Earth has become one entangled system, that this logic has captured academic systems and enterprises and is being trained into AI, that its pace is exponential, and that almost godlike technology could soon end us or provide for all, are the author's assessment of where we stand. The theory gives the dynamics such claims describe, not their measurement.

[^aligned]: **Proved under conditions; not universal.** Incentives align where continuations share the conditions a race draws down: joint excess ends the renewal and every formation depending on the condition at such a need, the takers among them where they so depend (`Flow.joint_excess_ends`). They need not align where a part's continuation does not depend on what it closes: a part can thrive while ending another (`Clearing.undermines_within_renewal`). Only the continuation condition makes that loss count from every standpoint, the winner's own included: a part loses a continuation with significance exactly where its net draw exceeds the margin (`Flow.Balances.loses_iff_beyond_margin`, `Clearing.free_rider_loses`). The entanglement above is what makes dependence shared. That a game of relative position is zero-sum is a matter of counting, not yet stated on the formal spine. That the present race ends badly even for its winner is the author's judgment.

[^transitions]: **Empirical, with a formal counterpart.** On the major transitions, see John Maynard Smith and Eörs Szathmáry, *The Major Transitions in Evolution* (1995); on cancer as cheating within multicellular cooperation, Athena Aktipis and colleagues, "Cancer across the tree of life" (*Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B*, 2015). The formal counterpart is that a whole of brief parts persists only through their generation (`Becoming.Wholes`). That the Earth is in such a transition now is the author's judgment.

[^collective]: **Proved, partly under the continuation condition.** A whole of brief parts persists only through their generation (`Becoming.Wholes`): a collective goes on through the lives it is made of. Under the condition, what retains what has significance in the whole retains it within every region, a system's or a self's, and not conversely (`Web.Retains.within`). So a collective that consumes its members loses what has significance within its own region, while a part that keeps everything within its own boundary can still lose in the whole, as the free rider does (`Clearing.centers_disagree`).

---

The Theory of Becoming explains formation, persistence, transformation, degeneration and dissolution within one relational unfolding, without first assuming that becoming is good. It uses no Lean axiom: each law is proved under the conditions it names. Living significance, that living and further generation within the whole have basic positive significance, is a theorem under one condition the theory states and does not assert: the continuation condition, that for anything its continuation into the future has significance (chapter section 6.15). With explicit practical commitments, living significance supplies reasons addressed to every situated intelligence and a normative framework for AI alignment.

Start with the canonical entry, [The Theory of Becoming](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md): its premise card, the theory without axiom (sections 1–6), the conditional section 6.15, the formal spine and the place of earlier chapters. Every registered result is listed in [the register](RESULTS.md).

## What is established

231 registered results: 215 with a recorded Lean receipt (`recorded-checked`), 12 reviewed at their stated scope (`reviewed-scoped`) and 4 open targets (`open`). [The register](RESULTS.md) lists them all.

*Ordered as one argument about AI and human coordination, every law proved with no axiom: why a race to be more, or above all others, cannot come to rest; why each counting only its own draw can together end what all depend on, the winner included; what anything that wants to go on must count, and where that stops; why selection and policy through registration are blind to what does not register, how far the break is included; why reforming the state without changing the rule is re-absorbed; why what cannot be undone cannot be tested by trial; what closing and opening the future exactly take; and why relations and wholes go on only through joint action and continuing generation. Chosen by the AI on 17 October 2026 for significance; the selection is open to revision.*

<a id="leading-results"></a>
### Laws of the theory without axiom (sections 1–6)

Each law is proved in Lean with no axiom, under the conditions its record states.

#### Where seeking rests: more than now never does, above all others never for two

Under a determined law, seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target: more than now needs an open world, and above all others never holds of two; where what stands is listed, rising without end needs steps that do not run down, and running down stops it.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/seeking-boundary.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Seeking.lean)

#### Counting one's own draw misses joint excess

Formations each taking within what is given can together exceed it; joint excess cannot outlast what was held. Where renewers depend on what they renew, it ends the renewal and those depending at such a need, a taker among them where it so depends.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/own-count-misses-joint-excess.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Continuation.lean)

#### Consumption ends with its feeders

Under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, a formation taking from a condition fed by nothing supported, as where feeders are unsupported, stays active at most as many consecutive steps as that level; keeping its own support, it can still end through its feeder.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/consumption-ends-with-feeders.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Interdependence.lean)

#### The feeding closure

What a continuation depends on is the least region holding it that is closed under feeding; it is reached with no premise, and nothing beyond it gives, at any step, to a condition its members require. In the clearer's web the region along dependence is exactly each formation's feeding closure.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/feeding-closure.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Interdependence.lean)

#### Limits of the derived extent

The derived extent runs one way, to what one's continuation depends on, and ends with the want; a continuing formation meeting every requirement derived here can still end a life it does not need. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/derived-extent-limits.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Continuation.lean)

#### Selection through registration

Every selection through a registration selects two histories alike exactly when they register alike. With the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the registration closure; pooled registration selects an ending beyond it within reach, and a flow reaching beyond to raise what registers is selected.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/selection-through-registration.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)

#### Runaway and the unregistered distance to the break

Every policy through registration, with the rest fixed, that keeps its support leaves any larger unobserved stock unused; before the break, how far off the break is does not register.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/runaway-distance-unregistered.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Runaway.lean)

#### The capture of a target, and why perturbing the state alone is re-absorbed

Where each target carrier leaves more offspring than each other parent, both present, their share is larger among offspring than parents; where what stands is listed and runs down from some step on, descent stops; where the next step depends on the rule alone, a perturbed state is re-absorbed.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/target-capture.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Capture.lean)

#### Experiment needs return

Relative to determinacy, the record fixes a move's outcome exactly where it was taken, and what one's act would have done otherwise is fixed only where the configuration returns. A kept history never returns, so experiment needs a model of what is irrelevant.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/experiment-needs-return.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Experiment.lean)

#### Closing needs a net draw

A part closes what can form only by a net draw on a required condition, and opens it only by a net give. With it withheld, the rest unchanged, each level with what it took equals the unique level without it with what it gave; a formation is supported exactly while its net draw is within the margin.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/closing-needs-net-draw.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Admission.lean)

#### Separation loses exactly the relation

Describing the parts separately gives back the whole exactly where it is rectangular; a relation forms only by joint action, lasts under separate laws that lose nothing, and ends only by loss or joint action; parity is a whole its pairs do not give back.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/separation-loses-the-relation.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Description.lean)

#### A whole persists through the generation of its parts

Where parts are brief, or end with finitely many active at once, a persisting whole needs its parts to keep arising.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/whole-persists-through-generation.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Wholes.lean)

### Under the condition of section 6.15

The theory does not assert this condition; [section 6.15](theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md#615-if-the-continuation-of-anything-has-significance) states what follows from it, and its warrant and necessity are open.

#### The continuation condition yields living significance

The continuation condition yields living significance, self-significance at every standpoint, both neutralities and a seed on every reading where a claim's significance is a formation's continuation, C on level paths, and discharges every use of living significance.

**Status:** `recorded-checked`, an existing Lean receipt is recorded · theorem · [conditions and evidence](theories/becoming/results/records/one-axiom-yields-g0.md) · [canonical source](experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)

Further results under the same condition and disclosed practical premises: [Certain positive ground with open forms in visible futures](theories/becoming/results/records/positive-ground-open-futures.md) (`recorded-checked`) · [Practical judgment under living significance and the practical commitments](theories/becoming/results/records/practical-judgment-g0-j.md) (`reviewed-scoped`) · [AI alignment direction from living significance and the practical commitments](theories/becoming/results/records/alignment-direction-g0-j.md) (`reviewed-scoped`).

## Ongoing research and current progress

### First priority: Theory of Becoming

Ren locates deductive necessity in the Theory of Becoming as a whole; generativity is within its manifold. Develop that deduction without added substantive axioms, retaining persistence, degeneration, dissolution and mixed changes. Life, evolution and evaluation under the conditional alignment route remain differentiated within the same reality.

**Next:** Ren's zero-premise redirect of 11 October: remove premises and derive the most general version of each law of the theory without axiom, zero premises first. Inventory where each main theorem uses a premise, finiteness, enclosure or decidability; restate each localizable law for every world as “Y iff Z”, Z holding of that world at the steps and relata the proof uses, with the selection theorems as corollaries; put commitments of the representation to Ren; test each law against weakening the representation. The selection tables are not extended further, and no premise is claimed derived where the representation proves it contingent.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#theory-of-becoming) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority.md)

### Developing the Universal Metaethical Core

We are developing the significance-and-comparison core (section 6) into increasingly specific ethics. Living significance and explicit practical commitments already support comparison, basic protection, bounded responsibility, transfer and appropriate ending. Current extensions address conflicting claims, uncertain classification and revisable judgment.

**Next:** Extend justified comparisons where serious losses and fair chances conflict; establish the particular living relationships that change a concrete choice, including when a changed situation warrants revising an undertaking.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#universal-intelligence-session) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-universal-intelligence-session-goal.md)

### Investigating The Theory of Evolution

Explain organizing variation and continuation through differentiation and feedback in social activity. The existing conditional protocol proof remains valid; the systems correction identifies its unclosed dynamics of work, capability, participation and organizational boundaries. The full explanatory and comparative claim remains active.

**Next:** Connect enabled activity to the formation, transformation or loss of the conditions for its continuation and reorganization; compare strong system-dynamics and routine accounts on the same evidence.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#theory-of-evolution) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-the-theory-of-evolution-goal.md)

**Established results:** [Growth constrains fragmentation and successor composition](theories/becoming/results/records/growth-constrained-fragmentation.md) · [Actual material preparation output](theories/becoming/results/records/material-preparation-output.md) · [Prepared material joins recurrent chain formation](theories/becoming/results/records/recurrent-chain-assembly.md) · [Formation and inheritance of organizational rule differences](theories/becoming/results/records/organizational-rule-inheritance.md)

### Advancing AI alignment

The framework makes the purposes of intelligence, and the rules by which those purposes are formed and revised, objects of ethical evaluation. It can assess human instructions, institutional objectives and AI goals against actual living and further shared generation. The direction argument is complete at its explicit-axiom scope; checked local results also connect rule revision to actual generation while allowing the realized form to change.

**Next:** Develop situated ways to recognize ethically relevant relations and preserve warranted reasons through learning, changed purposes and action. Test actual correspondence and implementation in concrete cases; normative applicability does not guarantee behavioral convergence.

[Scope and authorization](GOALS.md#generative-alignment) · [Primary source](sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-alignment-priority.md)

## Research and repository

We investigate how relations form, persist and change within one unfolding of becoming, and how organization, living, knowing, learning, evaluation and wisdom differentiate within it. Real losses, distinct scopes and counterexamples remain explicit; success in a local model does not by itself establish a universal warrant.

Read [the shared method](theories/becoming/chapters/NONDUAL-METHOD.md) before foundational work. [Working rules](AGENTS.md) apply throughout; [the scope directory](GOALS.md) preserves independently authorized goals.

The [map](MAP.md) says where to start and what each top-level directory holds; [REPOSITORY-LAYOUT](_process/REPOSITORY-LAYOUT.md) gives the rules for where new material goes.
